description: Defines the ParamCommsDebugInfo class and related macros for debugging and recording parameter communication info in distributed training within the torch library.

classes.name: ParamCommsDebugInfo
classes.description: Holds debugging information related to parameter communication in distributed training, including process group name, rank, message sizes, data types, and split sizes.

methods.name: ParamCommsDebugInfo(std::tuple<std::string, std::string> pgName, int rank, std::string&& collName, int64_t inNelems, int64_t outNelems, at::ScalarType dType, std::vector<int64_t> inSplitSizes, std::vector<int64_t> outSplitSizes, int globalRankStart, int globalRankStride, int worldSize)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing all debug info fields.

methods.name: getRank()
methods.description: Returns the rank of the process.

methods.name: getWorldSize()
methods.description: Returns the total number of processes in the world.

methods.name: getGlobalRankStride()
methods.description: Returns the stride between global ranks.

methods.name: getCollectiveName()
methods.description: Returns the name of the collective operation.

methods.name: getInMessageNelems()
methods.description: Returns the number of input message elements.

methods.name: getOutMessageNelems()
methods.description: Returns the number of output message elements.

methods.name: getDType()
methods.description: Returns the data type of the tensors.

methods.name: getGroupRanks()
methods.description: Returns the ranks in the group.
